entries.title: QECLean
entries.subtitle: Formalization and verification in quantum error correction
entries.description: Independent verification research for quantum error-correcting codes, including cycle enumeration, boundary witnesses, homology and logical-weight bounds.
entries.status: Accepted and merged RLT-QEC-001/002a/002b records: 46 cycles below weight 8 and 46 boundary witnesses, ranks 41 and 41, homology dimension 8, and 8 ≤ d_X ≤ 10 in the 90-qubit base X sector. Lower bound reviewed completeness (R); upper bound checked certificate (V). Exact minimum and full Bravyi360 independent verification remain open.
